AppFunctionAppMetadata.appfn:description: Taiwan Ebook Search compares ebook prices across Taiwan stores by book title or ISBN. Operational Patterns: - Use pingAppFunctions only to verify the integration is registered. - Do not treat pingAppFunctions as a book search. - Later functions will search by title or ISBN, reload a snapshot by searchId, read recent local search records, and open a store product URL. Constraints: - Supported queries are book title or ISBN only. - This app does not purchase, log in, or manage a bookshelf. - Prices are not currency-converted. Unknown prices are not free.
